# Clip 1.3.12
Clip 1.3.12 refreshes the menu-bar experience and gives fullscreen Live Share hosts control over which apps contribute audio.
## Popovers and controls
- Use one consistent card, row, toggle, navigation, and button system across recording, Live Share, stream settings, and native viewer controls. - Keep popover height fluid as content changes, with compact spacing, aligned controls, full-row hover feedback, and clear primary actions. - Simplify room preparation, source selection, viewer controls, and streaming settings without changing their behavior.
## Live Share audio
- Exclude selected applications from fullscreen system-audio capture, helping prevent callers from hearing their own Discord or conferencing audio. - Apply audio exclusions live and preserve the existing app-window audio behavior.
## Requirements
Clip requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. This build uses the same stable Apple Development identity as previous updater releases.
